title: Soviet divers meet tall humanoids at Lake Baikal

plain: In 1982, the story goes, Soviet divers went down into Lake Baikal, a lake in the Soviet Union, to look for something and came face to face with very tall humanlike beings, an encounter that seems to have left them badly shaken. Michels raises it himself as a question to his guest, a treasure hunter named Dennis Asberg, without naming a source, and he breaks off before finishing it. If true, it would place strange beings deep underwater, far from where anyone expects them.
